comments.content: When `get_max_tokens_per_item()` returns a value, it is returned directly without filtering by `mm_counts`. The original path via `_get_mm_num_tokens(mm_inputs)` only includes modalities actually present given `mm_counts`. Here the returned mapping may include modalities (e.g. "video") that have a limit of 0 in `mm_counts`, or omit ones expected by callers. Consider filtering the returned mapping to the modalities in `mm_counts` (falling back to the dummy-input path for any missing keys) to keep behavior consistent.
